activation.reason: bridge HTTP is reachable but the EA poll/read path is stale and unhealthy
activation.shared_infrastructure_blocker: The bridge process is listening, but its attached EA is not polling; no fresh symbol metadata, quote, or H1/M15 read evidence is available. Repair/attach the EA and WebRequest path through the established operator workflow.

scope.outcomes: shared-research-outcome-resolver-v1 only; no max hold; open/unresolved retained separately
scope.costs: gross/reference only; no spread, commission, slippage, or net P&L

limitations: No live candle, setup, proposal, accepted entry, or theoretical outcome can be reported until the read-only bridge is available.
Historical availability/revision timestamps are not inferred by this observer; only source timestamps and observed-at timestamps are persisted.
A first snapshot is labeled reconstructed/warm-up and cannot generate a post-T0 entry.

rollback.stop: Do not start the observer; if started later, terminate its dedicated PID and remove only docs/research/price_action_forward/state/.
rollback.production_impact: none; no deployment, migration, signal, outbox, or execution writes were performed
